output.summary: A high-climbing vine native to upland tropical South America, though its exact native range is uncertain because it has long been cultivated there. It has hanging pink flowers and yellow or light-orange fruit containing many seeds in an edible orange aril. Its fruit has been cultivated since pre-Columbian times and remains sold in South American markets.
output.edibilityNote: Its yellow fruit and orange aril are edible; it has been cultivated since pre-Columbian times and remains sold in South American markets.
